# mimecast_attribute_types (Data Source)

Read all local and directory-linked attribute definitions with cursor pagination, sorted by ID. Requires Directories | Attributes | Read. Does not read address attribute values or modify directory configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_attribute_types" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable attribute type inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_in_views` (Boolean) Whether the type may be displayed in table views.
- `description` (String) Attribute type description.
- `id` (String) Attribute type UUID.
- `prompt` (String) Display label.
- `prompt_group` (String) Display group.
- `prompt_options` (String) Unmodified comma-delimited selection options from the API.
- `prompt_order` (Number) Display order within the group.
- `prompt_type` (Number) Input control type, including 50 for LDAP-linked attributes.
